items.exampleEn: Getting a visa for that country can be troublesome.
items.exampleZh: 申請那個國家的簽證可能很麻煩。

items.exampleEn: The smell of fresh coffee in the office was unmistakable.
items.exampleZh: 辦公室裡那股新鮮咖啡的香味絕對不會認錯。

items.exampleEn: The river takes a winding course through the valley.
The baby had rosy cheeks after her nap.
items.exampleZh: 小寶寶午睡後臉頰紅潤。
items.glossZh: 紅潤的；玫瑰色的；樂觀的

items.exampleEn: My grandmother had a serene smile on her face.
items.exampleZh: 我祖母臉上帶著安詳的微笑。

items.exampleEn: Many fans found the long wait for tickets unbearable.
items.exampleZh: 許多歌迷覺得漫長的排隊買票讓人受不了。
items.glossZh: 無法忍受的；難以承受的

items.exampleEn: The bird has bright scarlet feathers on its head.
items.exampleZh: 那隻鳥頭上有鮮紅色的羽毛。

items.exampleEn: She played the piano brilliantly at the concert.
items.exampleZh: 她在音樂會上把鋼琴彈得非常出色。

items.sentenceEn: The sun was shining brilliantly on the fresh snow.
items.sentenceZh: 陽光燦爛地照在新雪上。

items.audioEn: The noise from the construction site was unbearable, so we went to the library to study.
items.audioZh: 工地的噪音讓人受不了，所以我們去圖書館讀書。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼去圖書館讀書？

items.sentenceEn: A winding path led us down to a small beach.
items.sentenceZh: 一條蜿蜒的小路帶我們走到一片小海灘。

items.sentenceEn: Her voice was unmistakable, even on a bad phone line.
items.sentenceZh: 即使電話收訊不好，她的聲音還是一聽就認得出來。

items.stemEn: The ____ road had so many turns that I felt a little sick.
items.stemZh: 那條蜿蜒的路彎道多到讓我有點想吐。

items.stemEn: This old printer is so ____; it stops working almost every day.
items.stemZh: 這台舊印表機真麻煩，幾乎每天都會停擺。

items.passageEn: Last October, we drove up a winding road to a small lake surrounded by wilderness. The trip took four hours, and the heat in the car was almost unbearable. But when we arrived, everything changed. The lake was serene, and the maple trees around it had turned scarlet. In the evening, the sky turned rosy, and later the stars shone brilliantly above us. My father, who had complained in the car, was smiling for the rest of the night.
items.passageZh: 去年十月，我們沿著一條蜿蜒的路開上山，到一座被荒野環繞的小湖。車程四個小時，車裡熱得幾乎讓人受不了。但一到那裡，一切都不同了。湖面平靜，周圍的楓樹都變成了鮮紅色。傍晚天空染成玫瑰色，後來星星在我們頭頂閃閃發亮。在車上一直抱怨的爸爸，那天晚上一直都笑容滿面。

questions.questionZh: 去程讓人難受的是什麼？
傍晚的天空是什麼顏色？

items.promptZh: 那家公司的未來看起來並不樂觀。
referenceEn: The company's future does not look rosy.
The future of that company doesn't look very rosy.
rubricZh: 要用 rosy 表示「樂觀的」（例如 does not look rosy）
「看起來」可寫，例如 look、seem 等
否定寫法例如 does not、doesn't 等都可以

items.promptZh: 這位律師把這件困難的案子處理得很出色。
referenceEn: The lawyer handled the difficult case brilliantly.
The lawyer dealt with the difficult case brilliantly.
rubricZh: brilliantly 表示「出色地」，可放句尾或動詞前（例如 handled … brilliantly、brilliantly handled 等）
「處理」可寫，例如 handled、dealt with 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 handled、has handled 等）
